articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo in late October 2026, featuring a natively multimodal architecture that jointly reasons over text, images, audio, and video within a single forward pass. The model supports a 1-million-token context window with significantly improved recall accuracy, marking a step change in long-document and multi-session agentic workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad qualifying problem set, surpassing all previous AI systems. The model employs a novel chain-of-verification architecture that self-checks logical steps before committing to a proof path, significantly reducing hallucinated reasoning chains.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot entered pilot deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant and select Amazon fulfillment centers in early November. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and can autonomously adapt to new pick-and-place tasks after fewer than 10 human demonstrations, leveraging onboard vision-language-action models.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Construction Site Inspections
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed that its electric Atlas humanoid robot is conducting fully autonomous structural inspections at Skanska construction sites in the UK and US. The system combines real-time LiDAR SLAM with a fine-tuned vision model to identify defects, deviations from BIM plans, and safety hazards, generating compliance reports without human intervention.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Persistent Memory and Tool-Use Orchestration
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4 with a persistent episodic memory system that allows the model to retain user context across sessions without reprocessing full histories. The new architecture also includes a built-in tool-use orchestration layer that lets the model plan and execute multi-step workflows across APIs, databases, and code interpreters with improved reliability and auditability.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production has started on its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process, with first customers including NVIDIA and Apple. The node delivers approximately 35% improved performance per watt over N2, which is expected to enable a new generation of AI training and inference chips shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which features 4,096 electrodes—a fourfold increase over the first generation—and wireless data transfer at 200 Mbps. The expanded trial will enroll 50 patients with spinal cord injuries, aiming to demonstrate high-bandwidth bidirectional communication for motor restoration and sensory feedback.

articles.title: Figure AI and Microsoft Partner to Deploy Foundation-Model-Powered Humanoids in Data Centers
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a partnership with Microsoft to deploy its Figure 03 humanoid robots for physical data center operations including cable management, hardware swaps, and rack inspections. The robots run a jointly developed vision-language-action foundation model fine-tuned on data center operations, representing one of the first large-scale integrations of LLM-driven humanoid labor in critical IT infrastructure.
